title: GTFS Scorecard batch CSV row
description: One row of the CSV that `scorecard try --batch` reads, as an object of trimmed cell strings keyed by column name. The header must name every required column and no others. The command checks one thing this schema cannot: `country` must be an assigned ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, not only two letters. A value containing :// must be an http or https link; any other value is a path to a local zip, read relative to the CSV's own folder.

name.description: The name shown for the feed.

url.description: A direct http or https link to the GTFS zip, or a local path to one.

country.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the feed is validated under.

ntd_id.description: Optional NTD reporter id, carried into the rollup as a label. Blank means none.

large_feed.description: Optional. true applies the large-feed ingestion ceilings; blank means false.
